action: Built the parallax toolchain from scratch: render3d.py (numpy z-buffer rasteriser: perspective camera, directional/point lights, shadow map + PCF, haze, ACES, DOF/bloom primitives), type3d.py (fontTools variable instancing -> TrueType contour flattening -> earcut triangulation -> extruded solid meshes), validate_type.py (independent outline check), fonts/Archivo-var.ttf (OFL) + OFL-Archivo.txt
result: Four real bugs found and fixed by measurement, not guesswork: (1) TrueType qCurveTo implied-midpoint rule was wrong -> contours corrupted; (2) extruded side walls wound backwards because TrueType outer contours are clockwise -> black shards; (3) wall triangles indexed by len(wall_v) (a vertex count) instead of a wall index -> walls referenced wrong vertices; (4) rasteriser backface cull used the wrong screen-winding sign AND flipped the signed area used by the barycentric test, so front faces were culled. validate_type.py now PASSES 12/12 glyphs against fontTools SVGPathPen: outline deviation <1.5 font units, polygon area exact, triangulation area exact. Real 1080p frame with extruded KINETIC renders in 0.35-1.6s on 2 cores.
next_action: Commit concept + storyboard, build scene/render CLI, prove the hardest shot as a real 5-10s MP4
